player_prompt.intro:
Ni we Player {player_id} ukuteka bala ya Checkers nga {color}.
Tekeneni umusolo wenu mu notation ya chess-style [fileRank fileRank], fimo '[b2c3]' (kalamba cha a–h, digit ya 0–7).
Mikwito ikulu:
  • Musolo yenze kufupisha diagonal ku mpela umo.
  • Tekeni kwa kuyuka pamo na chipumi cha mupinzani.
  • Chipumi chinshi chenjeshi ukafika ku mutwe ushi.

invalid_move.wrong_format: No valid move format found. Use [a1b2], e.g. [b2c3].

outcome.black_no_pieces: Black has no pieces left. Red wins!
outcome.no_moves: Umulayi {player_id} takwete inshila na imbi iya kubomfya.
